blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A centenarian from Barangay San Francisco, Dingras, Ilocos Norte received a P100,000 cash incentive from the government for reaching the age of 100. Esperanza Longboy Asuncion was awarded the incentive under Republic Act No. 10868, or the Centenarians Act of 2016, which grants a cash gift to Filipinos who reach their 100th birthday. The visit and awarding on Friday (Nov. 13) were led by Dingras Mayor Joemelle Saguid-Go Sy.
